title: Delivery
slide_intent: Show how to make progress legible to someone waiting for a delivery, using a route and identifiable endpoints.
strategic_value: An Instacart-colored route and marker can carry the identity into a functional status view.
demonstration: A cream map card shows a delivery status heading, a route with bright and dark green sections, a circular marker and an orange destination pin.
practical_value: Choose a hierarchy that lets the person see status first, then find the marker and destination along the route.

content_islands.name: Status heading
content_islands.spec: Place the delivery message above the map inside a narrow cream card against dark green.

content_islands.name: Route map
content_islands.spec: Keep the base map pale. Use green line segments, a circular marker and an orange pin to distinguish progress and destination.
